description: Which coins really MOVE TOGETHER with a coin — Pearson correlation of hourly moves over the last 30 days with the whole market's move taken out first (otherwise everything just follows BTC). Top ~1,350 coins, rebuilt nightly. With `symbol` (1–5 coins): each coin's most correlated coins (score −1…1: 0.45+ strong, 0.3+ clear, 0.2+ some), their 24h move, its category, how closely it follows Bitcoin, whether it has USDT perpetual futures, and today's verdict — 'alone' = it pumped 8%+ above the market while its correlated coins stayed flat (in 2022–26 such solo pumps beat the market the next day only 36% of the time) or 'group' = a group move. With `symbol` + `vs`: how closely two coins move and whether one tends to move first (hourly). Use for 'what moves with X', 'coins like X', 'is X's pump real or alone', 'are X and Y the same bet', diversification. Not a lead signal: 'A moves, B follows' trades did not beat fees in Asrai's tests. For same-category projects see coin_info (similar_coins).

symbol.description: One or more coins, comma-separated (max 5), e.g. 'ORDI' or 'PEPE,ARB'

vs.description: Optional second coin: compare `symbol` with it (who moves first), e.g. symbol 'ARB', vs 'OP'

name: correlated_coins
